summary: Frontend-only visual verification of the 3rd-iteration category-chip icon swap on the Discover screen. Logged in via demo consumer (demo@consumer.com/password123) and cycled all 7 category chips (All/Music/Art/Tech/Food/Sports/Other) in the default (dark) theme, and captured Profile toggling into light theme. Bug FIXED: no rectangular / square / box artifact is visible inside ANY chip icon. Every icon now uses an organic, curvy Ionicons filled glyph — All=flame, Music=mic, Art=brush, Tech=flash, Food=pizza, Sports=football, Other=star — matching /app/frontend/app/(consumer)/discover.tsx:39-47. Explicit confirmations: (1) Tech chip is a LIGHTNING BOLT, not the previous 'laptop' rectangle. (2) Music chip is a MICROPHONE silhouette, not the previous 'musical-notes' note+beam block. Regression checks pass: chip active-state animation + colored border + halo still play on selection, chip label recolors to accent, header LinearGradient wash re-tints dynamically per category (pink for All, purple for Music, orange for Art, cyan for Tech, red for Food, teal for Sports), poster shelves ('Free & popular', 'More near you') render with FREE / price ribbons, event cards render category tag + date + distance, tab bar (Discover / My Tickets / Profile) navigates, login flow (continue-consumer -> fill-demo -> login-submit) works, and Profile Dark-theme switch flips the app light<->dark. No red screen. Note: The two Expo/RN console warnings from iteration_5 (shadow* deprecated, LinearGradient pointerEvents prop deprecated) still fire — carry-over from prior iterations, unrelated to this fix.

rca_of_issue: User reported (3rd time) a 'square box' inside category chip icons. Root cause this iteration: the 'laptop' filled Ionicons glyph literally IS a rectangle, and 'musical-notes' filled has a solid beam that reads as a rectangular block; both were used in iteration_5's outline->filled swap. Fix (applied by main agent): swap every category to a filled Ionicons glyph with NO straight-edge/box geometry — flame (organic curves), mic (rounded capsule), brush (thin curved handle), flash (triangular bolt), pizza (triangular slice), football (oval), star (5-point). Verified visually on dark theme by cycling all 7 chips; Tech is now a lightning bolt (no laptop rectangle) and Music is now a microphone (no note+beam block). Since Ionicons glyphs are theme-independent (only tint changes), the same non-rectangular shapes render in light theme.
